title: 10 · half_half · Half Him, Half Her
lines: A devotee once walked around Shiva,
and refused to walk around Parvati.
He loved Shiva so much, there was no room in him for anyone else.
I worship the Lord, he said. Only the Lord.
"I worship the Lord," he said. "Only the Lord."
So Parvati sat closer. On Shiva's lap.
Bhringi turned into a bee, and tried to fly between them.
So they closed the gap completely.
One body. Half him. Half her.
And the bee tried to bore through the middle.
Then keep only what came from your father.
Bone comes from the father. Flesh and blood from the mother.
Bhringi collapsed. A skeleton that could not stand.
And Shiva, out of pity, gave him a third leg to stand on.
There is no Shiva without Shakti.
No strength without the one who gave you your body.
